I used to be very sportive and do a lot outdoor activities. But now with my knee problems I couldn't do those things that I used to enjoy. I feel sad about it.
</message>
output: I keep thinking about how much I miss the feeling of wind in my hair and the freedom of movement that used to come so naturally, and it makes me feel a quiet ache whenever I see others running or climbing without any pain. There's a part of me that regrets not taking better care of my body earlier, and another part that's frustrated at being stuck indoors when I once thrived outside.
